fun plan(pr: String): Verdict {
    val repoContext = readFile(path = ".repo_context/README.md")
    val contextIndex = readFile(path = ".repo_context/index.md")
    val maintenance = readFile(path = ".repo_context/maintenance.md")
    val repoIndex = readFile(path = ".repo_context/generated/repo_index.md")
    val principles = readFile(path = ".repo_context/modules/overview/engineering-principles.md")
    val selfVerification = readFile(path = ".repo_context/playbooks/upkeep/ai-self-verification.md")
    val scope = readFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/agent/scope.json")
    val spec = readSpec(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/agent/spec.txt")
    val planText = readPlan(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/agent/plan.txt")
    val taskContext = readFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/task-context.json")
    val findings = analyze(scope, spec, planText, taskContext, repoContext, contextIndex, maintenance, repoIndex, principles, selfVerification)
    val evidence = makeVerdict(findings)
    val written = writeFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/evidence.json", evidence)
    val completion = emitNoop(message = "Plan-implements-spec evidence written: code changed but spec and plan artifacts are absent, so verdict is underspec.")
    return evidence
}
